  • Method Details

    • findScope

      public Attributes findScope(Collection<? extends Attributes> c)
      Returns the first Attributes that is present in the supplied Collection of Attributes, and their meta-attributes, for which an invocation of the scope(Attributes) method returns true, or null, if no such Attributes exists.

      The search is conducted in a breadth-first manner.

      Parameters:
      c - a Collection of Attributes; must not be null
      Returns:
      the first Attributes that is present in the supplied Collection of Attributes, and their meta-attributes, for which an invocation of the scope(Attributes) method returns true, or null, if no such Attributes exists
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if c is null
